assumptions: As-published network: the load susceptance is taken out of B_lap (the source: loads play no role in the small-signal admittance model, printed p. 4); the line charging and the declared bus shunt capacitance are kept, as in e9_ma2024_index.m; the pages of the source read do not settle them.

Y_GFL,i is this project's GFL port (reduced.port: PLL, current control and P/Q outer loops), common frame, injected current, converter base: the object of the source's eq. 17, with this bank's parameters.

Y_delta,j is this project's closed form (reduced.Ydelta, the s = 0 Thevenin fit B_in = 1/(w0 Leff) from the frozen VSM port), rotated to the common frame and mapped to the source's absorbed convention as -R Ydelta R' (gate G1m); the source's simplified eq. 45 is not used.

The realness rule of reduced.threshold (static root at w = 0 and interior crossings over 2 rad/s to 2 pi 55 rad/s, IM gate 1e-6, the largest real root binding) is the numerical route to eq. 40; the source scales a capacity until the equation holds with the dominant root on the imaginary axis.
Rows without CgSCR are read with CgSCR = 0; the rule is also reported on the rows with CgSCR.
The monitor's score in the paired tests is the five-seed score-averaged ensemble of the stored deployed predictions, the convention of e8_paired_test.py and r21_design_baseline.py.
not_established: Whether the GFL model of the source's [28] matches this project's port beyond its structure.
How the source treats line charging and other shunts.

Lemma 1's error term o(||N||): how closely the critical subsystem's root follows the full model's dominant root on this chain is measured only through the three rays' k* and the full-model labels of the test frame.
The orientation of the binding root (stable above CgSCR) is checked locally, by the sign of Re(ds/dlambda), not by a census of the subsystem's roots.
The source's own validation (its Table III on its 39-bus system) is not reproduced.

Why the closed-form Y_delta agrees only coarsely with the device (results.device_check) is not tested. A likely reason, not tested here: the closed form takes the GFM's Thevenin branch as a lossless inductance matched in magnitude (B_in = 1/(w0 Leff)), while the device's branch carries its virtual resistance (params.converter, dev.gfm_vsm_rhs). The project's own C_SGSI uses the same closed form.

definitions.gSCR: eq. 39 on the as-published network (the index of e9_ma2024_index_rows.csv, gscr_ma_noload)
definitions.CgSCR: eq. 40: the largest real positive eigenvalue of G(j w_c) = sum_i p_1i F^-1 Y_GFL,i - delta_GFM over the static root at w = 0 and the interior crossings of 2 rad/s to 2 pi 55 rad/s (reduced.threshold unchanged)
definitions.rule: stable iff gSCR >= CgSCR (eq. 41); rows without CgSCR read with CgSCR = 0
definitions.beta: (gSCR - CgSCR)/CgSCR (eq. 41 without the factor 100); ranked by -beta
definitions.rule_interior_family_only_sensitivity: the rule with CgSCR taken from the interior crossings alone (the source's sideband reading), rows without one read with 0
definitions.monitor_alarm_md_amber: the test frame's alarm column, the deployed M+D AMBER-EBM seed 0 at its out-of-fold threshold (results/final/tables/e1_alarms.csv)
definitions.project_threshold_rule_context: lam_min < C_SGSI, the chain's own analytic threshold (context, not a comparator)
definitions.design_coordinates_amber_alarm_all_rows: results/tables/r21/r21_design_baseline.json arms.DC4.ebm.alarm (pooled only; FA is the false-alarm rate)
definitions.design_coordinates_logistic_all_rows: DC4 logistic classifier (results/tables/r21/r21_design_baseline.json strata AUC_DC4_LOGIT), all rows of the population
definitions.monitor_md_amber_ensemble: five-seed score-averaged ensemble of the deployed M+D AMBER-EBM (results/final/e8_test_predictions.npz)
definitions.monitor_md_amber_seed_mean_all_rows: mean over the five seeds of each seed's AUC (the Table II convention)
definitions.paired: on the rows with CgSCR: DeLong z and two-sided p; paired bootstrap of dAUC, 2000 resamples, RandomState(42), percentile interval 2.5 to 97.5
definitions.rays: probe at the artifact's k* - 0.005; grid k = 0.20:0.05:3.00 up to its first failed point; every sign change of gSCR - CgSCR bisected to 1e-5 in k; k_c the midpoint of the final bracket; rel_error_vs_kstar = (k_c - k*)/k*; n_sign_changes, closest_approach (the grid point of largest gSCR - CgSCR), binding_family_at_every_point and interior_only_bracket are the outcome of the superseded sign-change gate, reported as results
definitions.crossing_orientation: sign of Re(ds/dlambda) of the binding root of det(lambda I - G(s)) = 0; negative when a larger gSCR moves the root into the left half plane (the orientation the rule presumes)
definitions.device_check: on the test frame: cosine and relative error of the closed-form R Ydelta R' against the VSM port with the swing live minus the frozen port, both at s = 0 (and the cosine at 1 Hz), taken at the worst GFM plant of each row; n_rows rows
definitions.rule_counts: the rule on the test frame (stable iff gSCR >= CgSCR, rows without CgSCR read with CgSCR = 0): rows, rows with CgSCR, rows where the static root binds, rows declared unstable, and among them the full model's unstable and stable rows
definitions.superseded_gates: gates of the first gated run that were restated: kept with their realized values, reason and successors; they do not count in the tally
definitions.low_support: fewer than 10 unstable or 10 stable rows
